objective_value: <float> Total operating cost across all vehicle duties, summing depot pull-out, trip-to-trip transition, and depot pull-in costs.

routes.depot: <int> Identifier of the depot from which this vehicle is pulled out and to which it returns at the end of the day (1-indexed).
routes.trips: <list[int], length variable> Ordered sequence of trip identifiers performed consecutively by this vehicle between leaving and returning to the depot (1-indexed).

num_vehicles: <int> Total number of vehicles dispatched across all depots to cover every trip.
